unit.why: A brief anecdote, quoted from Vayechal Moshe, about R. Meshullam Zusya at a crossroads holding his tzitzit and unifying the Name to find the right road.
unit.boundary_note: part of a compilation of sources on tzitzit; the previous division is a teaching and the next division is a separate quoted account

stories.end_quote: זהו הדרך לכו בו ומאין ידע וכו׳
stories.summary_en: R. Zusya, travelling and unsure which of several forking paths to take, took his tzitzit in hand, unified the divine Name, and declared which road was the right one.
